notes.title: V0.22.0 is now live
notes.content:
It's been a very busy couple of weeks, adding numerous new puzzles and maps to RuneSage.  The latest release combines these with significant improvements in performance, better graphical and audio effects, and various small tweaks to improve immersion and the flow of the game.

The full list of changes since V0.21.0 is as follows.


Added new map mechanic.
Added more maps to find.
Added more puzzles to solve.
Added more in-game help from NPCs.
Added destructable walls.
Added magic effects to treasure chests.
Added sound effect when viewing a map for the first time.
Added eight new achievements.
Improved layout of mages village.
Improved layout of the windswept hilltop.
Improved layout of the inland lake.
Improved layout of the castle courtyard.
Improved performance in the castle cellars.
Improved performance of spell effects.
Improved performance of mage graphics.
Improved levitation spell to make it easier for touchpad locomotion users.
Improved fire spell.
Improved scroll texts.
Improved bird AI.
Improved appearance of maps when viewed from behind.
Fixed bug with hidden pathways being highlighted after opening.
Fixed bug with camera judder when picking up maps.
Fixed bug with music sometimes not transitioning between areas.


Please note that although save games from previous versions are fully compatible with this latest release, the addition of several new maps to find will mean that you will need to go back to previously visited areas to discover them all to get 100% completion.

RuneSage is now almost complete.  I am expecting that there will now only be one or two more releases before the game exits Early Access, and is ready for a full release.  Please do keep sending your suggestions and feedback (to feedback@runesage.com - or post on the Steam forum), as every comment is really appreciated and helps make the game better.

notes.title: V0.20.0 is now live
notes.content:
The latest release of RuneSage focuses on pacing and balance of gameplay.  In practice, that means making the tutorial area much easier so you progress more quickly onto the main part of the game, and then adding more puzzles and opportunities for spell casting to give a richer, more immersive experience thereafter.

The full set of changes from V0.19.0 is as follows.


Added more places to use magic spells.
Added more NPCs to give clues to the harder puzzles.
Added more visual clues to the locations of the hidden pathways.
Added requirement to cast a spell to open chests.
Added requirement to grab the map out of a chest.
Added ice puzzles.
Improved behaviour of main menu to default to showing last selected option.
Improved graphics for the earth spells.
Improved audio for ice melting.
Improved audio for chest opening.
Improved layout of the forest mazes.
Improved layout of the hidden sun crystal area.
Improved scroll texts.
Fixed bug which could rarely cause the main menu to show no options.


Please note that, although save games are fully backwards compatible, the game mechanics with the treasure chests have changed.  Anyone who started playing on V0.19.0 or earlier will find that chests no longer automatically open, and instead you (and anyone starting with V0.20.0 and onwards) now need to cast a spell to open them, and then reach out and grab the maps that lie within.

As ever, please keep the feedback coming to feedback@runesage.com as every comment helps refine the game further as it approaches the end of Early Access.

notes.title: V0.17.0 is now live
notes.content:
I'm delighted to announce that the latest version of RuneSage available today adds the Lightning Rune together with new spells to cast, new puzzles to solve, new quests to complete and new crystal shards to find.  In addition, I've made a number of improvements that keep adding further polish to the game; improving both the graphics/audio as well as the general flow of the game to enhance the immersion.

Added eight new lightning spells.
Added the seven shards of the lightning crystal to find.
Added map to the lightning crystal.
Added four new achievements for lightning (rune / map / shards / crystal)
Added new achievement for completing the crystal shield.
Added three in-game maps to help find the sun crystal shards.
Added explosive effects to fireball & iceball spells.
Added rune specific effects to each of the hidden pathways.
Added more environmental clues to help find the hidden pathways.
Added more in-game help from the NPCs.
Added loading progress indicator.
Improved scroll texts.
Improved the in-game maps to the hidden pathways.
Improved performance when auto-saving.
Improved performance when spell casting.
Improved performance when loading.
Improved graphics of the crystal shield.
Improved graphics in the sacred grove.
Improved background audio effects.
Improved the layout of the castle moat.
Fixed bug with scroll text briefly fading while auto-saving.


This release marks a major milestone in the development of RuneSage as the game can now be fully completed to 100%.  The next stage of development is to focus on adding further polish to work towards a full release later this summer or early autumn/fall.  Your feedback on the game is hugely valued and every comment makes a difference and helps improve the game further - please share your thoughts either on the forums or by emailing direct to feedback@runesage.com

notes.title: RuneSage Update
notes.content:
The theme for this week has been to optimize, optimize and optimize some more.  What feels like hundreds of hours spent staring at performance profilers has really paid off and RuneSage is now running at a rock solid 90fps on all systems.  On our reference PC most scenes now render in under 5ms (thats more than 200fps), with occasional spikes up to 7 or 8ms (150fps) when loading assets from disk in the background, leaving plenty of headroom for those running older hardware.

What that means for you is that RuneSage is now a true open world game; completely seamless moving from one area to another.  As we've expanded the game world (the next version will have over double the area to explore than the current V0.7.0) this performance aspect of the game has become even more important and you'll now be able to enjoy the experience in silky smooth VR.

notes.title: RuneSage Update
notes.content:
Another very busy week with the focus on two major areas for the next version of RuneSage; a new rune and a huge performance increase.


The Winged Rune.  We've had great fun implementing the new winged rune which contains the power of flight.  With that comes lots of new spells (levitation, tornado etc) and new puzzles which need them to be able to solve, a new gemstone to find and a couple of new Steam Achievements.
Performance.  We've made some massive internal changes to RuneSage which have dramatically improved rendering performance.  We're currently looking at how best to "spend" that gain, where the most likely option will be to split it 50:50 between improving the look and feel of the game (higher resolution, better lighting etc), and lowering the minimum spec so that everyone benefits.


Alongside these the next version will also have a bunch of other minor tweaks (for example, the ability to reset puzzles back to their starting state) and improvements to pushing the game forward.  As ever, please keep your suggestions coming!

notes.title: V0.2.0 is now live
notes.content:
We're delighted to announce that the latest update to RuneSage is now live - and it's a big one!  This version brings a new challenge arena to test your skills against, together with Steam Leaderboards, significantly higher framerates and various other improvements to the adventure.  Full details as follows.


Added a new starting area (The Sacred Grove).  When gemstones are found in the main adventure, they appear back in the Sacred Grove and can be used to unlock additional content in the form of challenges.  You can return to the Sacred Grove at any point in the game by selecting the option from the menu (press the menu button on the controller, then select Game / Return To Sacred Grove), and resume your adventure back again afterwards (again, using a new menu option - Game / Resume Adventure).
Added 9 initial challenges (with more to come in future updates).  Once gemstones have been found, return to the Sacred Grove to play through various challenges that will test your skills.  Start with the "easy" challenge for an introduction, and then unlock the harder challenges by completing each stage. 
Added Steam Leaderboards.  Your scores for each challenge are saved to Steam Leaderboards, so you can compare your skills with everyone else...
Added interactable scrolls.  Point at the buttons on the scrolls to highlight them, then press the back button on the controller to click.
Added hands.  By default, the wand appears in the right hand, but you can just physically swap the controllers over (i.e. use the right controller in your left hand) if you prefer.
Added a keel to the boat to make it easier to manoeuvre.
Added a shortcut back after finding the light gemstone.
Added lots more information scrolls giving instructions on how to play the game.
Improved performance.  Frame rates have approximately doubled in most places throughout the forest, castle and dungeon areas.
Improved the detection algorithm for runes.  Runes now easier to draw.
Fixed a glitch in the audio when multiple sounds were playing at once.
Fixed several minor anomalies in the forest terrain (e.g. trees appearing in the middle of the paths).
Fixed an exploit when using teleport locomotion which allowed you to move through gates by sticking your hand through.
Fixed an exploit when not using teleport locomotion which allowed you to walk on water.


As always, your feedback is really appreciated.  Please drop by the discussion forums (here) as it would be great to chat with you more about what you'd like to see in future updates.  What kinds of challenges would you like to play? What more runes and spells would like to cast? Where would you like to see your adventure take you?

We look forward to hearing your ideas, and working with you to make your game the best it can possibly be.

notes.title: V0.1.2 is now live
notes.content:
As promised, the latest version of RuneSage now contains lots of configurable options for different styles of locomotion.


Teleport.  Press the trackpad on the wand controller to activate a magical beam, point it in the direction you want to go, and release to move there in a blink.
Dash Teleport.  Press the trackpad on the wand controller to activate a magical beam, point it in the direction you want to go, and release to move there in a straight line.  Fully configurable speed / time for the journey.
Trackpad/Touchpad (Headset).  Touch the top of the trackpad on the non-wand controller to move in the direction you're facing.  Touching left / right strafes, and the bottom of the trackpad moves you backwards.  The distance frrom the centre of the trackpad determines the speed.  Fully configurable maximum speed.  To climb up / over objects, press the trackpad on the wand controller to teleport.
Trackpad/Touchpad (Wand).  Touch the top of the trackpad on the non-wand controller to move in the direction the wand is facing.  Touching left / right strafes, and the bottom of the trackpad moves you backwards.  The distance frrom the centre of the trackpad determines the speed.  Fully configurable maximum speed.  To climb up / over objects, press the trackpad on the wand controller to teleport.
Trackpad/Touchpad (Non-Wand).  Touch the top of the trackpad on the non-wand controller to move in the direction the non-wand controller is facing.  Touching left / right strafes, and the bottom of the trackpad moves you backwards.  The distance frrom the centre of the trackpad determines the speed.  Fully configurable maximum speed.  To climb up / over objects, press the trackpad on the wand controller to teleport.
Armswing locomotion.  Press the trackpad on the non-wand controller to activate then jog on the spot to move in the direction you're facing.  The faster you swing your arms, the faster you travel.  Fully configurable maximum speed.  To climb up / over objects, press the trackpad on the wand controller to teleport.


The choice is yours!  Simply select which style you prefer from the main menu, configure it how you like it, and off you go!

We're continuing to update RuneSage and really appreciate all the fantastic feedback we've been getting.  Please keep it coming - we're listening and acting on it to make sure your game can be the best it can be.

notes.title: V0.1.1 is now live!
notes.content:
Many thanks for all the fantastic feedback to the initial release of RuneSage.  We're pleased to announce that the first update is now live bringing numerous improvements to the game.

Fixed tree rotation.
Fixed default graphics setting to be more reasonable.


Please keep the feedback coming.  Your comments are all really appreciated  - we're listening and acting on everything raised.  

The next release will focus on adding locomotion options - if there's anything else you like to see, please let us know!
